title: Nx: commit path_index/hydrate select-hang fix
description: Unstaged local changes after 2749e2b: path_index, nx_unavailable flag, hydrate_from_index, warm_path_index in discover.lua/pickers.lua. Commit separately from nx CLI env fix — keeps wizard usable while nx is broken.
acceptance_criteria: path_index/hydrate changes committed; select no longer sync-blocks on broken nx

title: Nx: workspace.proc_env for subprocess PATH/node
description: Shared env helper in workspace.lua for all nx/playwright vim.system calls. Merge login-shell PATH (zsh -lic) once, or resolve node and invoke node_modules/nx/bin/nx.js directly when wrapper exists but node missing from vim.fn.environ(). Wire into discover, graph, execute, playwright.
acceptance_criteria: nx show projects succeeds from GUI Neovim in monorepo where terminal nx works; all nx subprocesses use proc_env

title: Nx: daemon retry with NX_DAEMON=false
description: On nx show projects failure with daemon-related stderr, retry once with NX_DAEMON=false. Do not permanently disable daemon. Optionally mention nx reset in notification when lock/socket errors detected.
acceptance_criteria: Flaky daemon failures recover on retry; normal path still uses daemon

title: Nx: surface stderr + :NxDoctor diagnostic command
description: Add observability before env/daemon fixes. Show truncated stderr in refresh failure notifications. Add :NxDoctor (or similar) that runs node -v, nx binary resolution, and nx show projects --json from current workspace, printing full result for comparison with terminal.
acceptance_criteria: Failed nx refresh shows stderr snippet; :NxDoctor prints node version, nx cmd, exit code, stdout/stderr

title: Fix nx show projects failing in Neovim
description:
Symptom: Nx picker shows '237 projects loaded — nx show projects failed (saved glob fallback)'. UI resilience is largely done (async refresh, glob fallback, path_index/hydrate to avoid select hang). Remaining work: make nx CLI succeed in Neovim subprocesses, not just survive failure.

Diagnosis (cwd ruled out — glob finds 237 projects under correct root):
1. Node not on PATH in GUI/Cursor Neovim (most likely) — nx wrapper exists but #!/usr/bin/env node fails
2. Nx daemon bad state — retry with NX_DAEMON=false for read-only queries
3. Nx plugin/graph errors — need stderr surfaced
4. npx fallback worse in bare GUI env

Do NOT: sync nx on picker open, more glob, cache glob as nx-success.

Verify from failing workspace:
:lua print(vim.inspect(vim.system({'node','-v'},{text=true}):wait()))
:lua local r=require'nx.workspace'; local w=r.root(); print(vim.inspect(vim.system(r.nx_cmd(w,{'show','projects','--json'}),{cwd=w,text=true,env=vim.fn.environ()}):wait()))

title: Nx: disk cache source field (nx vs glob)
description: When nx fails and glob fallback writes disk cache, record source: glob. On load, prefer re-probing nx when last write was glob (do not treat glob cache as proof nx works). Prevents stale glob data after Node/daemon is fixed.
acceptance_criteria: Cache JSON includes source; glob-sourced cache triggers nx retry on refresh

title: Nx: timeout on refresh_list vim.system
description: refresh_list async vim.system has no timeout (run_nx uses 15s). Add matching timeout so daemon wedge cannot hang refresh indefinitely.
acceptance_criteria: refresh_list passes timeout to vim.system; hung nx aborts and falls back
